blocks.title: Scalability
blocks.text: Scalability algorithm ki woh salahiyat hai ke input data barhne par, us size se kahin zyada jis ke liye banaya gaya tha, tab bhi kaarkard rahe.

blocks.prompt: Binary search linear search se behtar scale kyun karti hai?
blocks.explanation: Is ka waqt log n ki tarah barhta hai: das lakh tarteeb wali cheezon ke liye sirf taqreeban 20 jaanchein, jabke linear search ko das lakh lag sakti hain.

items: Scalable algorithms input barhne par bhi kaarkard rehte hain.
